title: Chana Masala with Cucumber Raita
description: The substantial 11.2g fiber content creates a slow, sustained digestive breakdown. The lactic acid and protein from the yogurt raita further blunt postprandial glycemic excursions.
diabeticNotes: The substantial 11.2g fiber content creates a slow, sustained digestive breakdown. The lactic acid and protein from the yogurt raita further blunt postprandial glycemic excursions.

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil or ghee

steps.title: Sauté Aromatics
steps.description: Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger for 4 minutes until golden.

steps.title: Toast Spices
steps.description: Add coriander, cumin, garam masala, and turmeric; toast for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Simmer Tomato Gravy
steps.description: Add crushed tomatoes and 1/3 cup water. Simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer & Thicken Chickpeas
steps.description: Stir in chickpeas. Lower heat and simmer gently for 10–12 minutes, lightly crushing a few chickpeas with the spoon to thicken the gravy.

steps.title: Whisk Cooling Cucumber Raita
steps.description: In a small bowl, whisk Greek yogurt with grated cucumber, chopped mint, and roasted cumin.

steps.title: Serve Warm with Raita
steps.description: Serve warm Chana Masala topped with a generous dollop of cooling Cucumber Raita.
